items.text: Ladd McConkey now has been ruled out with a concussion.
items.why: Head injury evaluated mid-game vs Chiefs.
items.implication: McConkey out rest of game; Chargers WR targets to others like Johnston/Quentin.
items.opportunity: In-game pivot to remaining Chargers pass-catchers.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.implication: Palmer steps in; Bills WR targets redistribute vs Raiders.
items.opportunity: Palmer and other Bills WRs see bump.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings practice squad Tuesday).
items.why: Ankle injury; only limited practice Friday, pregame workout failed.
items.implication: No Judkins means committee of small McLaughlin and practice-squad Estime; avoid Browns RBs.
items.opportunity: Low-end RB depth or pure desperation only; no clear lead back.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.why: Groin injury popped up on weekend report.
items.implication: Colts TE streamers elevated; Warren owners need pivots.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Colts pass-catchers.

items.text: Actives today include: Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren.
items.implication: Williams starts for Bears; Olave/Kamara full go for Saints; Dowdle available Cowboys.
items.opportunity: Full workloads expected for returning stars.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active.
items.why: Knee issue cleared for game after full Friday practice.
items.implication: Spears available for Titans backfield share vs Colts.
items.opportunity: Flex/streaming RB option in deeper leagues with recent target spike.

items.text: Whoa! Tyler Warren inactive surprising. Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among my fave streamer TEs.
items.why: Warren out opens TE streaming window.

items.text: I have Cam Skattebo at RB28, Najee Harris at RB33... still starting Cam for explosiveness/TD chance vs NO but riskier flex now. Prefer Najee over DK sometimes.
items.why: Rotation risk post-fumbles; still likes boom potential.
items.conflict: Levitan efficiency data supports further fade.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Expectation of larger Najee Harris role with Skattebo downgraded but still in mix.
items.why: Poor efficiency (YOE 37th) + 4 fumbles; sources indicate Najee larger role.
items.implication: Skattebo riskier flex; prefer split or Najee in some spots vs Saints.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris role expansion; monitor snap share.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Skattebo explosiveness for TD chance but ranks RB28 riskier.

items.text: Summary of weekend #FantasyFootball reports: GAME-TIME DECISION Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren, Mike Evans, Christian Kirk; EXPECTED TO PLAY Caleb Williams, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson, DK Metcalf, Pat Freiermuth, Kenyon Sadiq; NOT EXPECTED Deebo Samuel, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Sean Tucker; ACTIVATED Jaydon Blue.
items.implication: Track GTDs closely pre-kick; expecteds safe starts.

items.text: Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) loved for soft Commanders defense matchup as pass-catcher buffet.
items.why: Washington defense nightmare for WRs; volume expected.

items.text: Drake London vs CHI (WR6) loved with bankable usage.
items.why: Reliable role and targets vs Bears.

items.text: George Kittle vs WSH (TE3) loved due to Commanders defense struggles vs TEs.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak TE defense.

items.text: Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) loved for elite recent usage and leaking Cardinals run defense.
Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8) loved for volume and goal-line role vs Packers.
Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) hated for tough Seahawks matchup and QB issues.
Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34) hated due to lack of recent targets and tough matchup.
items.why: Struggled to get fed lately + Steelers defense.

items.text: Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18) hated for shaky usage and matchup.
